events.summary: A combined guidance, roster, and authorization projection exceeded its presentation budget and earned no complete-read credit.
Bounded file-specific windows completed every required guidance and schema through EOF without mutation.
The first raw activation-packet projection exceeded its output budget and was incomplete.
Bounded line windows completed the exact committed activation packet through EOF and verified its normalized-LF digest.
A source-fetch wrapper returned no attributable fetch result and earned zero fresh-live-equality credit.
A fresh literal ref fetch followed by scalar local, upstream, tracking, and live-remote comparisons established exact equality.
The first per-blob manifest validator crossed its command-yield boundary and left one owner-started read-only probe running.
Persisted process state was inspected, the bounded probe was allowed to finish, and no mutation or canonical credit was claimed.
A stop request raced with an already-exited owner-started probe and returned a missing-process error.
The process table and Git state confirmed that the read-only probe had already exited and changed no repository byte.
A second per-blob validator crossed its command-yield boundary and earned zero manifest credit.
The exact owner-started probe was identified and stopped, then a single Git batch-object replay completed the immutable comparisons.
A naive byte-count interpretation treated twenty CRLF-projected YAML checkout files as digest mismatches.
The predecessor contract was reread and all normalized-LF Git-blob digests matched; raw checkout-byte differences retained zero failure-conversion credit.
The worktree-creation wrapper yielded before the sparse checkout finished and returned no completion credit.
The existing registration and checkout were inspected in place after completion; the fresh named lane was clean at the exact source.
The first sparse-checkout extension used an unsupported add subcommand option and changed no pattern.
The supported literal add form extended only the declared Vesper x1 manifest path.
The first patch-helper invocation was rooted at the app workspace and created three untracked Vesper-named files outside the D-first lane.
Only those three newly created files were removed with the patch helper; a verified junction then routed patch edits to the intended Vesper worktree.

The first source-bounded semantic audit rejected three exact inherited titles and ten additional titles at or above the preregistered 0.75 token-Jaccard ceiling, then stopped before writing x1 documents.
Only the thirteen cited Vesper titles were rewritten with narrower microfilm-specific semantics; every unflagged proposal and the immutable source remained unchanged before the isolated audit retry.
The first exact staged diff-hygiene check rejected one extra blank line at the x1 builder EOF.
Only the extra EOF blank line was removed; the affected manifests and diff-hygiene dependency were regenerated without replaying the successful x1 test invocation.
The first mechanical x2 template copy used a PowerShell line count that omitted blank records and truncated several untracked Vesper files before staging or execution.
The untracked truncated files were replaced only from exact predecessor Git blobs using the correct record count; no evidence, test, or canonical credit was claimed.
The first bounded owner-code scan found inherited Neris source and x1 hashes plus meteorological template labels in the untracked x2 scaffolding.
Only Vesper-owned untracked scaffolding was corrected to the immutable Neris source, frozen Vesper x1, microfilm domain, current roster, and protected route before builder or test execution.
